statement.text: Peak request volume is the sole cause of the synthetic service failure.

sources.passage: Failure occurred during a high-volume interval.
A high-volume interval completed without failure.

uncertainty.description: Request volume may interact with another unmeasured variable.

assumptions: The two synthetic runs used comparable instrumentation.
competing_hypotheses: Failure requires both high volume and a second latent condition.
Failure is independent of request volume.
contradictory_evidence: High volume occurred without failure in run-2.

missing_information.reason: No measurement for the possible interacting variable is present in the fixture.
